<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אלול_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920460_theRebbe_154" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_9C_D7_95_D7_9C_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920460_theRebbe_154__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the covenant described in the verse involves both parties passing through one body, signifying their union into one flesh, which reflects the unity of Hashem with the Jewish people even in the physical body, specifically for the purpose of a dwelling place in the lower realms.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is what the verse continues,</t>
    <t s="2">“to pass you into the covenant,”</t>
    <t s="3">[For “to pass you into the covenant” is an explanation of what was said before this, “You are standing today, all of you,” etc.,</t>
    <t s="4">and as it is brought in Likkutei Torah,</t>
    <t s="5">that in this it explains how it is the way of unity and what is the matter of teshuvah and why specifically on Rosh Hashanah],</t>
    <t s="6">and as explained in Likkutei Torah,</t>
    <t s="7">it is like two lovers who cut a covenant between them, that they are bound to each other as if they became one flesh.</t>
    <t s="8">For this is the manner of cutting a covenant, as it is written,</t>
    <t s="9">“which they cut with the calf, and they passed between its parts,”</t>
    <t s="10">meaning that the fact that both of them pass within one body indicates</t>
    <t s="11">that they became one flesh.</t>
    <t s="12">And it is precise in Likkutei Torah that they became one flesh,</t>
    <t s="13">and likewise both of them pass within one body,</t>
    <t s="14">because the unity of the Holy One, blessed be He, with the Jewish people is also from the aspect of the physical body,</t>
    <t s="15">and on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="16">from the aspect of the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms, the dwelling place for His Essence and Being is specifically in the lower realms.</t>
    <t s="17">And as it is written,</t>
    <t s="18">“I have come to My garden,” and our sages said,</t>
    <t s="19">“to My garden, etc., for the primary Shechinah was in the lower realms,”</t>
    <t s="20">for specifically in the lower realms is the aspect of “My garden” and “My garden,”</t>
    <t s="21">for the matter of a garden indicates delight and His pleasure, as it were,</t>
    <t s="22">and delight and pleasure are specifically in the lower realms.</t>
    <t s="23">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="24">for behold, it is explained in Iggeret HaKodesh, the discourse beginning “He and His life are one, He and His limbs are one,”</t>
    <t s="25">that the coming into being of the created entity is through the power of the Essence, whose existence is from His Essence and is not caused by any cause that preceded it, Heaven forbid,</t>
    <t s="26">therefore the revelation of the Essence is</t>
    <t s="27">(not in His life-force and also not in His limbs, but rather)</t>
    <t s="28">specifically in the created entity.</t>
    <t s="29">And as explained in Biurei HaZohar,</t>
    <t s="30">that the true existence of the created entity</t>
    <t s="31">(what appears as a [separate] entity)</t>
    <t s="32">is the true entity.</t>
    <t s="33">Therefore, the cutting of the covenant and the bond of the Holy One, blessed be He, with Israel is primarily in the body of Israel,</t>
    <t s="34">and as explained in the well-known sichah,</t>
    <t s="35">the connection of the Essence specifically to the physical body.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that Hashem asks Israel to coronate Him, which awakens the revelation of His inner Kingship from His Essence and Being, and that the ultimate purpose is the service of souls within bodies.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4) And this is the meaning of the statement, “Before the Kingship verses: that you coronate Me over yourselves,”</t>
    <t s="1">that His Essence, as it were, invests Himself in all Jews and in every Jew,</t>
    <t s="2">“that you coronate Me over yourselves.”</t>
    <t s="3">For although He took counsel with the souls of the righteous,</t>
    <t s="4">that there arose before Him, as it were, the delight that He would delight in the service of the souls,</t>
    <t s="5">and this delight was before creation, as per the teaching of the Maggid of Mezritch in Likkutei Amarim and Beurei HaTorah at their beginning and commencement,</t>
    <t s="6">nevertheless, He asks that “you coronate Me over yourselves,”</t>
    <t s="7">for He took counsel with the souls of the righteous,</t>
    <t s="8">and the ultimate intention is the service of souls in bodies,</t>
    <t s="9">through which is brought about “you coronate Me over yourselves,”</t>
    <t s="10">to arouse</t>
    <t s="11">the revelation of the inwardness of His Kingship from His Essence and Being.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the annual covenant before Rosh Hashanah, which comes after a descent, is a higher level than the covenant at Chorev, as it involves teshuvah that transcends measurement and limitation, uniting even the physical body with Hashem's Essence.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is “to pass you into the covenant,” etc.,</t>
    <t s="2">that each year before Rosh Hashanah there must be a new cutting of a covenant regarding the acceptance of the Torah, which is analogous to the covenant that was before the entry into the Land of Israel the first time,</t>
    <t s="3">aside from the covenant which He cut with them at Chorev,</t>
    <t s="4">for at the time of the covenant which He cut with them at Chorev, Israel were righteous,</t>
    <t s="5">and after the descent</t>
    <t s="6">(caused by sin),</t>
    <t s="7">it was necessary to have “to pass you into the covenant of Hashem your God,”</t>
    <t s="8">the aspect of teshuvah.</t>
    <t s="9">And this covenant</t>
    <t s="10">(of “to pass you into the covenant”)</t>
    <t s="11">that comes after the descent as above,</t>
    <t s="12">a descent for the sake of an ascent,</t>
    <t s="13">is superior to the covenant which He cut with them at Chorev,</t>
    <t s="14">for “to pass you into the covenant” is</t>
    <t s="15">that those who cut the covenant pass between the parts “within one body,” which is the matter of the bond of the Holy One, blessed be He, with Israel, that they become truly one,</t>
    <t s="16">to the extent that even the body of Israel is unified with His Essence, as it were,</t>
    <t s="17">(as above),</t>
    <t s="18">that from the aspect of this bond, it is brought about, “Seek My face; Your face, Hashem, I will seek,”</t>
    <t s="19">[and in a manner that “My face”</t>
    <t s="20">(of Israel)</t>
    <t s="21">and “Your face, Hashem,” become one],</t>
    <t s="22">the service of teshuvah</t>
    <t s="23">(which is above the service of the righteous).</t>
    <t s="24">For the matter of teshuvah is above measure and limitation,</t>
    <t s="25">above the limitation of time, therefore teshuvah is in one hour and in one moment,</t>
    <t s="26">and above the limitation of place, including also the limitation of spiritual place, for the matter of place in spirituality is level and degree,</t>
    <t s="27">therefore even when he is on the lowest level</t>
    <t s="28">(due to sins, etc.),</t>
    <t s="29">teshuvah is effective.</t>
    <t s="30">And this is what the verse continues,</t>
    <t s="31">“And Hashem your God will return your captivity,”</t>
    <t s="32">it does not say “He will cause to return” but rather “He will return,”</t>
    <t s="33">for from the aspect of the cutting of the covenant of the Holy One, blessed be He, with Israel, that they became truly one,</t>
    <t s="34">and also from the aspect of the body of Israel, which is a holy nation and in the ultimate holiness,</t>
    <t s="35">behold, in every place where Israel is found,</t>
    <t s="36">even if you will be driven to the ends of the heavens,</t>
    <t s="37">there is found His Essence and Being, as it were,</t>
    <t s="38">since they are truly one,</t>
    <t s="39">and therefore it does not say “He will cause to return” but rather “He will return.”</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
